title: Official Davidson sites, version 1
description: official-sites.yml at the root of dc-choreo-workflows: the websites College Communications authorizes, which the overlap check compares a new app's purpose against.

source.description: The page College Communications publishes the list on.

as_of.description: The date the list was last checked against the source, YYYY-MM-DD, in quotes.

name.description: The site's name, as College Communications lists it.

url.description: The site's address, https only. Null for a platform with no single site, such as Google Sites.

purpose.description: What the site is for, in College Communications' words. The overlap check compares a new app's purpose against this.

owner.description: The office that owns the site.

aliases.description: Other hostnames the site is known by.

replaces.description: Hostnames of retired sites this one replaced, so an app duplicating the old site is still caught.
